rules.description: Zero horizontal overflow across PC viewports (1085 / 1440 / 1920px).

White cards on gray (#FAFBFB) sections must NOT have borders; white cards on white (#FFFFFF) sections MUST have a border (#DEE0E3 / #E5E5E5). Gray borderless product cards on white sections are restricted solely to Homepage and PLP.
No CSS linear/radial gradients on backgrounds or scrims; use solid rgba(0,0,0,0.45~0.58) overlays for white text on imagery.

#C00000 is restricted to primary conversion buttons, active nav indicators, prices, form errors, and duotone-line icon accents. Never use on content-reading Read More buttons, brand names, ordinary tags, or 4-sided card borders.
Clickable card titles stay #19191A on hover with underline (text-underline-offset: 3px); never turn #0060BF blue on hover.

Non-clickable feature/benefit icon grids should sit directly on the section surface (transparent, no card box, no hover shadow). Never wrap static items in clickable *-single-event cards with hover elevation.
Never mix icons from different styleFamily groups (e.g. duotone-line vs duotone-surface vs flat-illustration) within the same section.
All content images must load (naturalWidth > 0) with valid aspect ratio and zero solid-color placeholder blocks.

Same-weight featured horizontal cards on a page must share the same CTA component (TextButton inline-blue-link per FS horizontal card spec), reserving filled-red strictly for lead-gen/purchase conversion CTAs.
